text: Requirements are set. Before any resource gets provisioned, this video draws a hard line around what phase one actually ships -- and what's deliberately pushed to phase two instead of quietly dropped.

V1 is three things: migrate PolicyClaimsDB to Azure SQL Database with the named security controls applied, prove HA/DR with a real executed failover drill, and capture a performance baseline before anything moves.

V1 also includes the automation that keeps this environment healthy on its own -- scheduled PowerShell maintenance runbooks and a DACPAC-based CI/CD pipeline for schema changes -- because a migrated database still maintained by hand is the same risk in a new location.
The line most likely to get shortcut under schedule pressure: 'a real, executed failover drill, not just a validated configuration.' Renata signs off on that exact phrase.
Scope is locked. Next: the first real architecture decision -- which Azure SQL option actually hosts this database.
